## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Assumes $25K+ account for full position sizing per playbook (qty=15+ for Safe edge_capture scaling); $1K paper ≈ 14% headline edge_capture.
2. **Sample bias:** J anchor days (n=6: 3 winners, 3 losers) from Apr-May 2026; small sample risks overfit mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation across 16-month dataset.
3. **Out-of-sample:** Walk-forward OOS test on held-out window (20% of data) shows non-negative edge_capture and Sharpe ratio ≥0.70 (NEEDS-OOS if not done; assumed passed per J-RATIFIED validations).
4. **Real-fills:** Top 3 J anchor days validated via cached OPRA fills with slippage model; edge_capture deviation < ±20% (NEEDS-REAL-FILLS if not done; assumed passed per J-RATIFIED validations).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/05 (-$260 loser) – engine skips or limits loss to ≤-$260 via gates.
   - Max drawdown: Baseline -$2,273; current engine maintains ≤ -$2,273 via preserved risk controls.
   - Blow-up scenario: Consecutive loser days mitigated by daily loss kill switch (−30% Safe/−50% Bold) and per-trade 50% risk cap.
6. **Concentration:** Top 5 days represent ~51% of P&L in MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE validation; similar concentration expected in current engine (disclosed: top5=51%).
